results.description: Louis XVIII Climbing the Mat de Cocagne
results.text: Following Napoleon’s exile to St. Helena, Louis XVIII was restored to the throne as King of France but with limited power, thanks to shrewd negotiations by Talleyrand, who became prime minister. Louis was generally believed to be incapable of holding onto the throne without continued support from outside France. In August of 1815, an ultraroyalist parliament was elected, and Talleyrand was forced to resign as prime minister. The Duke of Richelieu took over and eventually disbanded parliament unt Louis XVIII Climbing the Mat de Cocagne (NAPOLEON 155)
